name: Wisesheets
description: Wisesheets gives your AI instant access to institutional grade financial data without the terminal price. Pull income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and hundreds of financial metrics sourced directly from SEC EDGAR (XBRL), plus historical and real time stock prices, dividends, and key ratios like P/E, ROIC, and margins for public companies. Ask for any company's fundamentals, screen an industry by revenue growth, build a DCF, or generate a tearsheet without leaving the chat. An affordable alternative to Bloomberg Terminal, Alpha Vantage, and Financial Modeling Prep, trusted by 70,000+ investors and analysts worldwide.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wisesheets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wisesheets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wisesheets.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wisesheets MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wisesheets provides these MCP tools: get_company, get_dividends, get_financials, get_prices_eod, get_prices_live, get_statements, list_metrics, search_companies, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wisesheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wisesheets in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Wisesheets requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wisesheets is developed by Wisesheets Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
